novelty_definition: cosine distance to nearest familiar reference; not a probability
limitations: Reference-unfamiliarity is not scientific species novelty.
Source grouping reduces, but cannot eliminate, near-duplicate leakage.
Small-sample results do not establish ecological or regional generalisation.

diagnostics.interval_note: Wilson intervals assume independent images; shared dives reduce independence.

archive_note: Numeric results only; LOCAL_CROP placeholders identify local files by basename. Use the runner to generate a usable image gallery. Provenance checksums refer to the original local manifests.
